notes: The RTSP path follows the stream-profile number: profile N is served at /video.proN (the manuals list /video.pro1 to /video.pro4), default RTSP port 554. The access name and per-profile authentication can be changed under Network > Advanced > RTSP, and each profile's codec and resolution are user-defined under Video > Profile, so which profile is the main or sub stream depends on the camera's profile setup. Printed verbatim in the archived Zavio user manuals for D4210, D4211, P6210, F3210/F3215, D7320/D7510, B7320/B7510, B8210, D8210, B6210, B8220, D8220, D8X20, D4X20, P4X20, P4520, CB321X, CB5220/CB6X30 and CD5220/CD6X30. The 2012-2014 manuals for B5010, B5111, B5210, B7210, D3100/D3200, D5113/D7111, D5210/D7210, F3000, F3102/F3110, F3201/F3206, F7210, P5111 and P5210 describe the same per-profile RTSP configuration ('Configure the RTSP by profile', 'Access Name') without printing the default path, and no readable manual is archived for B6220/B6320/B6520, D6210/D6220/D6320/D6520, CD3210/CD3211 and CL7200/CL7500 — treat the path as the brand default on those models, not as model-specific documentation. Older lines use different documented paths, set on those camera records: first-generation megapixel models (B5110, D5110, P5110) use one path per codec (/video.h264, /video.mp4, /video.mjpg, /video.3gp), and legacy VGA models (F210A, F312A, M511E, F531E, F731E) document only /video.3gp, the 3GPP mobile stream.
